text:
cassie: quick UX review: users keep overlooking Export in Trace Inspector. idea: surface a lightweight export affordance aligned with the correlation id instead of burying in kebab.
rafa: agree, kebab is too hidden during incident triage. one-click export is important.
mina: what if we show a compact export icon next to the ID and keep a full 'Export trace' button in the header for bulk/export-all? keeps copy/id action primary.
oliver: accessibility note: icon must have aria-label and be keyboard focusable. when activated it should open a modal with proper focus trap.
cassie: mock: [export icon] [copy id] <id string>  — icon opens quick menu (JSON/CSV), header has full Export trace.
rafa: small copy text change: current tooltip "Copied!" ambiguous. change to "Trace ID copied" so screen reader and clipboard users know what was copied.
mina: agree. also filename: ops asked to include timestamp + short id. suggestion: redwood-trace-20260323-1a2b3c4d.json (shortid = first 8 chars).
oliver: implementers: ensure filename is editable in dialog and there's helper copy under input: "We include the timestamp; edit if needed."
cassie: a11y checklist: focus moves into dialog on open, Esc closes, focus returns to triggering element, dialog has aria-modal and role=dialog.
mina: keyboard order inside dialog: format radios -> include spans checkbox -> filename input -> Export primary -> Cancel. Export should be primary action.
rafa: live region for copy: add an aria-live region that announces "Trace ID copied". debounce announcements to avoid spam if clicked repeatedly.
oliver: also ensure visible focus indicator for keyboard users (outline or focus token). add aria-describedby linking copy button to helper text for long ids.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-23T18:00Z for branch trace-inspector-export-nits.
cassie: copy nits: dialog title -> "Export trace" (not just "Export"). Confirm/button -> "Export" not "OK".
mina: i'll take dialog copy + helper text + filename pattern doc.
rafa: i'll update figma with header export and icon placement.
oliver: i'll add aria labels & focus behavior to prototype and add keyboard-only focus styles in tokens.
cassie: i'll add a short note to staging release notes about filename change so SREs know to expect it. reconvene after staging smoke tests. :thumbsup:
